The '''BlasTech E-17d sniper rifle''', or '''Rebel sniper rifle''', was produced during the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:E-17D_sniper_rifle.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A Rebel marksman using an E-17d]]
Shots from the [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] E-17d [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] were extremely accurate over long distances and remained coherent enough to provide a long-distance punch. The barrel shroud was perforated along its entire length, giving the weapon a distinctive appearance. The E-17d had a higher magnification level on its scope than [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] sniper rifles but carried a slightly smaller magazine,<ref name="BF I guide" /> with only five shots per magazine.<ref name="BF I" />

==History==
Throughout the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the E-17d was used extensively by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|Rebel Marksmen]] against Imperial [[Soldier/Legends|troops]].<ref name="BF I" />

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Visually, the weapon is nearly identical to the [[DLT-20A blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-20a blaster rifle]], just as the [[E-11s sniper rifle/Legends|E-11s]] and [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x]] are nearly identical to the [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]].
